source.name: HDX HAPI, food prices market monitor (WFP market data)

about: WFP market prices republished by OCHA's Humanitarian API, one schema across countries. Values are converted to the price per kilogram from the unit the market publishes; markets that sell by the litre, bunch, piece or tuber are left out because those are not masses. Crops are matched by name, and processed forms (flour, meal, gari, oil) are never treated as the crop. A country with no rows in the window is absent rather than carried forward.
